title: juniperus deltoides var. spilinana
intro: Juniperus deltoides var. spilinana, commonly known as Rocky Mountain juniper, is a species of evergreen coniferous tree native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, helping to alleviate respiratory issues and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Juniperus deltoides var. spilinana include expectorant, diuretic, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating conditions like bronchitis and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
